headline: Onelife Capital Advisors submits SEBI dematerialization compliance report
hook: Routine regulatory filing for Onelife Capital
summary: Onelife Capital Advisors has filed its mandatory compliance certificate with SEBI regarding the dematerialization of its shares. This filing confirms the company's adherence to regulatory standards for electronic shareholding. Such submissions are standard procedural requirements for listed entities in India. The filing ensures the company remains in good standing with market regulators.
why_it_matters: Routine regulatory compliance with no direct impact on share price.

headline: Onelife Capital Advisors submits revised voting results and scrutinizer report
hook: Corrected voting tallies filed after filing error
summary: Onelife Capital Advisors Limited has submitted a revised scrutinizer's report and corrected voting results to the exchanges following an inadvertent error in the original PDF filed on October 1, 2026. The original data from the meeting held on September 29, 2026, contained discrepancies that required an official correction. For retail investors, this administrative update ensures accurate corporate governance records but carries no direct impact on the company's financial performance or stock valuation.
why_it_matters: Purely administrative filing error corrected with no financial impact.

headline: Onelife Capital Advisors submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
summary: Onelife Capital Advisors Limited has submitted its scrutinizer report and voting results for the Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026. The filing complies with standard regulatory disclosure requirements for listed entities. This procedural update has no immediate financial impact on the company's operations or valuation. Indian retail investors holding the stock face no immediate consequences from these routine filings.
why_it_matters: No direct consequence for your portfolio from routine AGM filings.
